evidence.title: Worker Roles and Process as Code — Cobalt Docs

name: Worker Roles and Process as Code
summary: Cobalt docs on reusable worker roles — coding, review and QA instructions — and versioned process-as-code definitions.
description: Documentation for Cobalt's worker roles: reusable instructions in Markdown (name, stable key, description) that a task or a Loop selects, with the role revision captured when a message is accepted. The process-as-code part downloads worker roles and workspace-visible Loop definitions as a JSON package for Git, and roles can be created or refined by the Cobalt assistant, by a task agent or by hand in workspace settings.
contains: worker roles: reusable instructions for jobs such as coding, review and QA
a role has a name, stable key, description and Markdown instructions
ask the assistant or a task agent to draft and refine roles
role revision captured when a message is accepted; queued work keeps its instructions
download worker roles and workspace-visible Loop definitions as a JSON package for Git
manage roles from workspace settings or an external client
